svg.data-vd-steps: [[0, "Collagen: a fibrous protein."], [1, "Three polypeptide chains, each with glycine as every third amino acid."], [4, "They wind together into a triple helix."], [7.5, "Many triple helices line up, staggered, with covalent cross-links: a fibril."], [11, "Result: great tensile strength, and insoluble."]]
svg.title: Collagen
svg.desc: Collagen: three polypeptide chains with glycine every third amino acid wind into a triple helix; many molecules lie staggered side by side with covalent cross-links forming a fibril with high tensile strength.

g.data-info: Three long polypeptides; every third amino acid is glycine, the smallest amino acid, so the chains can pack tightly.
The three chains wind round each other, held by hydrogen bonds: one collagen molecule.
Many molecules lie side by side, staggered, joined by covalent cross-links between neighbouring molecules.
Very high tensile strength and insoluble: ideal for tendons, ligaments, skin and bone. A fibrous protein.

g.text: very high tensile strength · insoluble · tendons, skin, bone
